mapper.update: UPDATE voucher_operation SET version=#{version},status=#{status},attempts=#{attempts},highest_revision=#{highestRevision},state_json=#{stateJson},updated_at=#{updatedAt},next_attempt_at=#{nextAttemptAt},lease_until=#{leaseUntil},reversal_id=#{reversalId} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND input_json=#{inputJson} AND command_digest=#{digest}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM voucher_operation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
SELECT state_json FROM voucher_operation_revision WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND operation_id=#{id} AND version=#{version}
SELECT * FROM voucher_operation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND application_id=#{applicationId} AND round_no=#{round} AND kind=#{kind}

SELECT r.state_json FROM voucher_operation_revision r WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND r.operation_id=#{id} AND r.version>GREATEST(COALESCE((SELECT MAX(d.resolved_version) FROM voucher_dispute_resolution d WHERE d.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND d.operation_id=r.operation_id AND d.outcome='POSTED'),0), COALESCE((SELECT MAX(t.released_version) FROM voucher_reversal_retirement t WHERE t.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND t.operation_id=r.operation_id),0))

SELECT q.tenant_id,q.id,q.trace_id,a.business_no,s.process_instance_id FROM voucher_operation q LEFT JOIN approval_application a ON a.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND a.id=q.application_id LEFT JOIN approval_submission_round s ON s.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND s.application_id=a.id AND s.round_no=q.round_no WHERE (q.status IN ('QUEUED','UNKNOWN') AND q.next_attempt_at<=#{nextAttemptAt}) OR (q.status IN ('POSTING','QUERYING') AND q.lease_until<=#{leaseUntil}) ORDER BY COALESCE(q.next_attempt_at,q.lease_until),q.created_at,q.id LIMIT 10
SELECT version,state_json FROM voucher_operation_revision WHERE tenant_id=#{parameters[0]} AND operation_id=#{parameters[1]} ORDER BY version
SELECT version,state_json FROM voucher_operation_revision WHERE tenant_id=#{parameters[0]} AND operation_id=#{parameters[1]} ORDER BY version
